fields.body_md:
## At a glance

KAIST is a science and technology university in Daejeon, South Korea. This page uses its **School of Computing** master's programme to show real costs and entry rules.

- **Tuition:** **KRW 9,559,000** a semester for 2027 (**₹6.64 lakh**). That is **KRW 19,118,000** a year (**₹13.28 lakh**).
- **Fall 2027 deadline:** apply from 7 January to 5 February 2027. KAIST announces decisions on 28 May 2027.
- **English test:** IELTS **6.5**, or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (new scale), or TOEIC 720, or TEPS 326. Some Indian applicants can skip it.
- **Scholarship:** the KAIST Scholarship can cover full tuition and a monthly stipend. You choose it on the application form.
- **Money for the visa:** KAIST says to show **USD 16,000** (**₹14.87 lakh**).

Rupee amounts use **₹0.0694 per Korean won**. We built it from the RBI rate and the Bank of Korea closing rate for 27 November 2026. Your bank's rate will differ.

## What you pay

KAIST charges **KRW 9,559,000** a semester for most departments in 2027. KAIST says the fee changes every year. A master's degree needs about two academic years.

KAIST's average budget for a student on campus is **KRW 5,350,000 for each 6 months** (**₹3.72 lakh**). It covers a dormitory, food, transport, books and health insurance. Students who live off campus should expect costs to be 35% to 50% higher. Read our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/south-korea/south-korea-cost-of-living).

## Who can apply

- You must hold a bachelor's degree, or expect to hold one by the end of August 2027.
- Your degree must be equal to a four-year Korean bachelor's degree.
- You must not hold Korean citizenship.

## English test

You need one of these scores, taken on or after 5 February 2025:

| Test | Minimum score |
|---|---|
| IELTS Academic | 6.5 overall |
| TOEFL iBT, taken on or after 21 January 2026 | 4.5 |
| TOEFL iBT, taken before 21 January 2026 | 83 |
| TOEIC (Listening and Reading) | 720 |
| TEPS | 326 |

KAIST does not accept TOEFL ITP scores. It does not accept IELTS One Skill Retake.

India is on KAIST's list of countries for an **English-medium waiver**. You need to have studied your bachelor's degree or higher in India with English as the medium of instruction. You send a certificate of English medium of instruction and pick the waiver on the form.

## Dates for Fall 2027

| Step | Date |
|---|---|
| Online application | 7 January, 10 AM, to 5 February 2027, 5 PM (Korea time) |
| Decision announced | 28 May 2027 |

The application fee is **USD 80** (**₹7,433**). It cannot be refunded. KAIST says some applicants can ask for a fee waiver.

## Scholarships

Choose the **KAIST Scholarship** as your financial resource on the form. KAIST says it covers full tuition, national health insurance and a monthly stipend. The stipend depends on your research work. KAIST says 94% of its international students benefit from it.

Master's applicants are also considered for the **KAIST Global Presidential Scholarship (KGPS)**. It gives full tuition and **KRW 1,000,000** a month (**₹69,448**) for 4 regular semesters. You do not apply separately. The department head recommends only highly competitive applicants.

KAIST decides scholarships separately from admission.

## Visa and money

KAIST says to show a bank balance of **USD 16,000** or more when you apply for the visa. Read our [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/south-korea/south-korea-proof-of-funds-guide) and [D-2 visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/south-korea-student-visa-guide).

## Sources

Official pages, checked on 28 November 2026: [KAIST Fall 2027 International Graduate Admission guide](https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr/cmm/fms/FileDown.do?atchFileId=FILE_000000000483722&fileSn=1), [KAIST yearly timelines](https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-graduate/Admission/YearlyTimelines), [KAIST eligibility requirements](https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-graduate/Admission/Eligibility), [KAIST Scholarship](https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-graduate/FinancialSupport/Scholarship/KAISTScholarship), [RBI exchange rates](https://www.rbi.org.in/) and the [Bank of Korea ECOS statistics](https://ecos.bok.or.kr).

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at KAIST for a master's degree?
faq_json.a: KAIST charges KRW 9,559,000 a semester for most departments in 2027, which is about ₹6.64 lakh. KAIST says the fee changes every year.

faq_json.q: What is the KAIST deadline for Fall 2027?
faq_json.a: The online application is open from 7 January to 5 February 2027. KAIST announces decisions on 28 May 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does KAIST need?
faq_json.a: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall. KAIST also takes TOEFL iBT, TOEIC and TEPS. India is on its list for an English-medium waiver.

faq_json.q: Can Indian students skip the English test at KAIST?
faq_json.a: Yes, if you studied your bachelor's degree or higher in India with English as the medium of instruction. You send a certificate and pick the waiver on the form.

faq_json.q: Does KAIST give scholarships to Indian students?
faq_json.a: The KAIST Scholarship can cover full tuition, health insurance and a monthly stipend. Master's applicants are also considered for the KGPS, which gives KRW 1,000,000 a month, about ₹69,448.

faq_json.q: How much money does KAIST ask me to show for the visa?
faq_json.a: KAIST says to show a bank balance of USD 16,000 or more, about ₹14.87 lakh.
